scoring_justification: T1 recompute feasible: annealing barriers recomputed from NEB profiles, band gaps extracted from DOS, charge density minima taken from bond profiles; formation energies compared to hidden paper reference with tolerance (the gold is the paper-reported value).

hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported formation energies; they serve as the hidden reference for comparison.
These are the paper's own reported annealing barriers; they serve as the hidden reference for the recomputed barriers.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Section 3.2 text and Figure 6 caption: perfect 5.25, A 4.90, B 4.80, C 5.01, D 4.86 eV
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported band gaps; they are the hidden reference for the gaps extracted from DOS.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Section 3.2 text: perfect 0.327, A 0.309, B 0.288, C 0.318, D 0.301 e/Bohr³
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported N-N bond minimum densities; they serve as the hidden reference.

outputs.description: Formation energy E_F of each orientational defect, computed as total energy difference between relaxed defect cell and relaxed perfect crystal cell.
Energy of each replica along the CI-NEB minimum-energy path for each defect. The annealing barrier is recomputed from this profile as max(energy) - energy at replica 0.
Electronic density of states for the perfect crystal and for each defect. The band gap is extracted as the HOMO–LUMO gap from this data.
Electron charge density along the most charge‑deficient N–N bond for each defect. The minimum value along the bond is the scored quantity.

output_contract.notes: All scored artifacts are compared against hidden reference values derived from the original study using tolerances appropriate for a recomputation with an open‑source DFT code. The NEB profile allows the checker to recompute the annealing barrier for each defect.
